scope: Wave 7 existing drafts QA only; no new authoring
inspection: Original deterministic 18-row sample native and both mobile sizes preserved; five prior supplementary native reopens preserved. Seven formerly truncated rows reopened one at a time at native/320/160. Additional targeted text/color native reopens use prior mobile inspection where no mobile dispute remains. Never count repeated reopens twice.
counting_basis: Field-level correction events, including earlier 18 provisional fields. Text-convention normalization and bounded uncertainty included in minor factual count. Style count includes 72 image-specific expression-label reconciliations from existing authoring evidence, not 72 new image reopens.

warning_adjudications.reason: Red gym underlines are heading/category emphasis, not danger. Native rechecked, narrative explicitly negates warning.
Red what if? badge is branding, not danger. Native rechecked, explicit negation removes regex false positive.
Native/320/160 rechecked. Two prominent tokens; incidental financial microtext separately bounded as partly readable native, unreadable mobile. Uncertain strings not asserted.
Red EARN IT is motivational emphasis, not danger. Native rechecked and negative wording explicit.

score_monitor.reason: Wave 7 is near prior 68.5 and 66.9 means. Relative to Wave 6, niche and style mix differ: finance POV 35 vs 32; ancient-human/animal explainer 16 vs 9; cartoon 50 vs 48; photo 1 vs 5; channels 32 vs 27. Differences plausibly affect visual scores; no paired calibration evidence establishing inflation.

counterexample_logic: Four same-batch visual-opposite references added, grounded in reopened sources. NONE_IN_BATCH elsewhere means no qualified visual opposite selected for that row, not absence of all possible opposites. Neither raw views nor score/view disagreement establishes a performance counterexample.
text_convention: For this wave, word_count and text track prominent package wording. Incidental interface, credential-clothing and environmental microtext is preserved in qa-field-evidence-B002-19-21.json. Deliberately enlarged narrative proof labels and brand logos remain package wording. Numeral group/hyphenated term one token; standalone currency icon excluded; ampersand counted.
limitation: 40 unique images were reopened across the two QA sessions; remaining 32 receive mechanical checks, not independent visual re-review. Generic expression labels were reconciled from authoring observations. Current-public creative is not historical creative-performance proof. No content verification or medical advice assessment was performed.
